failing_contracts.observed: fatal: Invalid revision range 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..HEAD, gate exit 1
failing_contracts.proves: the gate treats a boundary outside the history as a violation rather than as a declaration that does not govern that history.

how_it_was_found: The full battery at fb47fd4 reported ten failures across pre-r0007-close-controls and pre-r0007-remediation-3. Every one of them runs the literal ci:governance command inside a contract fixture. Fixtures are fresh histories that copy the real law/policy/governed-sequencing.json, so they carry a boundary commit they cannot contain, and the newly wired gate failed closed on all of them. The cause was reproduced directly in a throwaway repository in seconds rather than inferred from the run, and the battery was stopped once superseded. That stopped run is INCONCLUSIVE and contributes no rows.
note: The defect is in the control added by 87aa821, not in the R7-F012 repair it was built to protect. The real repository always contains the declared boundary, so treating an unreachable boundary as not applicable removes no protection there.
